crossroads.name: The Crossroads
crossroads.divine_relationship: Many traditions meet beneath the Hearth's roof.

nordia.name: Nordia
nordia.divine_relationship: The gods are impressed through courage, oaths, sacrifice, and protection.
nordia.dungeon_doctrine: The prisoners are enemies of the gods. Destroy them before they break free.

zarabia.name: Zarabia
zarabia.divine_relationship: Divine and spiritual powers are approached through relationship, offering, office, and negotiated obligation.
zarabia.dungeon_doctrine: Ancient powers cannot simply be killed. Their bonds must be understood and renewed.

helvetica.name: Helvetica
helvetica.divine_relationship: The gods are served through public duty, law, temple, and institution.
helvetica.dungeon_doctrine: The seals are divine law and must be restored correctly.

verdant_concord.name: Verdant Concord
verdant_concord.divine_relationship: Sacred places and old agreements must be respected.
verdant_concord.dungeon_doctrine: The prisons themselves are poisoning the living world.

veiled_isles.name: Veiled Isles
veiled_isles.divine_relationship: Spirits permeate ordinary life; obligation and ancestry shape practice.
veiled_isles.dungeon_doctrine: Some prisoners were misnamed or unjustly confined.

sun_crowned_dominion.name: Sun-Crowned Dominion
sun_crowned_dominion.divine_relationship: Divine order contains chaos through names, cycles, death rites, and preservation.
sun_crowned_dominion.dungeon_doctrine: Every breach threatens cosmic order, but an ancient sentence may be amended lawfully.
